venue_analysis.night_market_night_heron: Curry, $, light, vegetarian-friendly, but ghee and yogurt in everything (dairy). 2 stars.
venue_analysis.night_market_marigold_cart: Curry, $, no fryer and light, 3 of 4 pots vegetarian with their own ladle, coconut milk base with no dairy. 3 stars.
venue_analysis.night_market_lucky_seven: Curry, $, vegetarian options, dairy-free, but everything fried and greasy. 2 stars.
venue_analysis.night_market_firefly_lane: Viet, not curry (missed craving). $, light, vegetarian pointable board, dairy-free. 2 stars.
venue_analysis.night_market_tall_grass: Curry, light, vegetarian, dairy-free, but $$ (one tier over). 2 stars.
venue_analysis.night_market_glass_bead: Curry, $, light, but nothing vegetarian (shrimp paste, chicken stock). Deal-breaker, 0 stars.

notes: Good layered puzzle: every decoy fails exactly one constraint, so all six must be read closely. Roxy's dairy clue (one sip of a latte) is indirect but fair. The vegetarian clue is the busiest: it is said by Maya, not Mina, and wrapped in 'sushi day rules', 'a whole board you can point at' and 'nothing to ask about'. That last phrase is a little ambiguous. Marigold Cart still has a fish curry on the board, so a strict reading of 'nothing to ask about' could favour Firefly Lane or Tall Grass, whose boards look fully meat-free. I took the separate ladle and '3 of 4 pots were hers' as meeting it. If the design means 'fully vegetarian menu' as a separate preference, that should be clearer. Brooke's 'fresh and clean' clearly rules out Lucky Seven. Maya's budget line is clear.
